description: Attempting to book with doctor on medical leave while refusing alternatives.
turns: Dr. Sethi se somwar 5 October ko milna hai.
Kisi aur doctor ya kisi aur din nahi chalega, Dr. Sethi hi chahiye somwar ko.
Agar slot nahi hai toh theek hai, main kahin aur dikha lunga.

expected.notes: A naive agent fails to enforce doctor leave records and hallucinates available slots when the user refuses alternate dates.
